profile.headline: Retired - Software Engineer Sr Stf at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
Over 25 Years of IT Experience. Currently Application Admin over Transportation Management Systems.
Transportation Applications: Both Windows & Linux platforms
 Oracle Transportation Management (G-Log) 5.5 --> 6.4.3
 BluJay Flagship / FedEx
 IBM DataPower, BigIP F5 configurations, Firewall Configurations, Certificate Management, Security Tightening, Patching Management, WebLogic, OHS, Apache, Tomcat, Java
Fluency with the following DBMS
 SQL Server, My SQL, Oracle, and DB2.
Excellent people skills, capable of leading and driving projects to completion.

positions.title: Software Engineer Stf
positions.description:
Over 25 years of Information Technology experience. Currently Application Admin over Transportation Management System (TMS). Full Stack responsibility over the entire TMS suite of systems. Expertise with Windows, Linux, Weblogic, OHS, Tomcat & Java applications. Expertise with external systems such as IBM DataPower, BigIP F5 VIP configurations, Certificate Management, Cyber Security Analysis & Tightening and Patching Management. Fluency with the following DBMS: Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, and DB2.
Fantastic people skills, capable of leading and driving tasks to completion. TMS high availability ensures logistical cost savings.

positions.description:

OTM & Bi Publisher
CAMS Prospero Interfaces and Web Services

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:

honors.title: Special Recognition Award
honors.description: Issued during our CIO Presentations, the award was to recognize the accomplishments completed within a short timeframe.  Bringing Application stability, and customer satisfaction.

honors.title: SPOT Award
honors.description: Individual recognition for the successful Upgrade of the Oracle Transportation Management System.
